goal: One narrow governance correction from canonical main b9557d50d81b811b15bee3b96097a8f1423d6f36 in milestone_contracts/governance/career-os-document-rendering-capability-v1-contract.json extending the DPKG_CONFIG_CHECK_V1 parsing grammar (DPKG_OPTION_SYNTAX_V1) with only the unquoted whitespace-separated value form required by the observed stock Ubuntu 24.04 dpkg configuration, specifically the line `log /var/log/dpkg.log`. The prior grammar admitted only `<dashes><name>` and `<dashes><name>=<value>`, so the stock Ubuntu 24.04 /etc/dpkg/dpkg.cfg line `log /var/log/dpkg.log` (an unquoted value separated by whitespace) was DPKG_CONFIG_MALFORMED and the OPERATOR-class dpkg record could not be captured. The correction adds the whitespace-separated value form with one unambiguous normalization (the `=` form and the separator form normalize identically) and changes no other rule. The parser remains intentionally stricter than dpkg itself and fail-closed: it does not claim to recognize every syntax dpkg accepts, and quoted option values stay outside the admitted subset and fail closed (a deliberate restriction, not a claim that dpkg rejects them). The host dpkg configuration is not modified to fit the grammar. No implementation, dependency, installation, provisioning, release, merge or submission authority is created.

DPKG_OPTION_SYNTAX_V1: a non-ignored dpkg configuration line is exactly one of `<dashes><name>`, `<dashes><name>=<value>` or `<dashes><name><SEP><value>`, the form being decided by the first byte after <name> (end of line, `=`, or space/tab); the `=` form is unchanged byte for byte; the separator form takes the remaining bytes with trailing spaces and tabs removed, non-empty, not beginning with `=`, a space, a tab, a double quote or a single quote; the `=` form and the separator form normalize identically (so `log /var/log/dpkg.log` normalizes to [log, /var/log/dpkg.log]); every other shape, including quoted values, remains DPKG_CONFIG_MALFORMED and fails closed by deliberate restriction of this check.

Unchanged and not weakened: dpkg file discovery, type, ownership and mode checks; exact file SHA-256 recording; ordered option recording; exact approved-record comparison; every DPKG_CONFIG_NEVER_APPROVABLE rule and all force-* and hook prohibitions (decided by the normalized name regardless of separator syntax); NO_DEBSIG_EXACT_ADMISSION_V1; diversion, statoverride and policy-rc.d checks; SOURCE_EXPANSION_V1, CONFIG_CHECK_V1 and UPDATE_SEMANTICS_V1; HOST_PRECONDITIONS_V1; and the separation of gates (1) to (5).

The proof vectors establish: (1) the stock `log /var/log/dpkg.log` form parses to [log, /var/log/dpkg.log]; (2) `name=value` behavior remains; (3) valueless options remain; (4) malformed lines remain rejected; (5) never-approvable options remain rejected regardless of separator syntax.

The host /etc/dpkg/dpkg.cfg is not modified, the provisioning script and verifier keep zero authority to edit dpkg configuration, and updating the verifier and provisioning-script parsers to this grammar and refreshing the implementation contract identity are separate later passes.
